profile.headline: Principal / Staff Software Engineer | Technical Lead | C#/.NET SQL Server | Healthcare, Public Health Systems
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer and technical leader with more than 20 years of experience designing, developing, and improving enterprise applications across healthcare, public health, financial services, and other industries.

I specialize in C#, .NET, SQL Server, software architecture, complex business logic, and modernizing legacy systems. I enjoy tackling difficult technical challenges, particularly those that require understanding the bigger picture, working through complicated requirements, and developing practical solutions that are reliable and maintainable.

Throughout my career, I've served as a technical lead, managed software development teams, mentored engineers, and collaborated directly with customers and business stakeholders. My experience includes designing systems that process millions of healthcare messages and patient records, developing clinical decision-support functionality, improving application performance, and helping teams adopt better development practices.

Although I've held formal management positions, I've always enjoyed being hands-on with technology. I believe strong technical leadership comes from understanding both the systems being built and the people building them.

What motivates me most is solving problems that matter. I want the software I build to make people's jobs easier, help organizations operate more effectively, and ultimately make a positive difference for the people they serve.

I am particularly interested in Staff and Principal Software Engineer opportunities where I can combine deep technical expertise, architectural thinking, mentoring, and hands-on development to help teams build better software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer and technical lead, I design, develop, and modernize enterprise public health applications while providing technical direction, mentoring engineers, and helping teams deliver reliable solutions.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

Technical Leadership: Lead technical design discussions, review code, mentor developers, guide implementation decisions, and collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to solve complex problems.

Healthcare Data Engineering: Independently designed and developed a data quality analysis solution processing millions of HL7 messages and patient audit records. Defined scoring criteria with customers, optimized complex SQL queries, validated results, and automated monthly reporting.

Application Modernization: Redesign and migrate legacy ASP.NET WebForms functionality to MVC, improving maintainability while preserving complex business requirements.

Clinical Systems: Developed complex Hepatitis B vaccination scheduling calculations based on clinical rules and direct customer collaboration.

Performance and Architecture: Implemented batching for long-running Windows services to prevent timeouts. Contributed to the architectural design of asynchronous email processing to improve application responsiveness.

Quality and Reliability: Improved integration testing pipelines, established clearer team ownership, troubleshot failures, and addressed security and dependency issues.

Customer Implementations: Develop complex SQL configuration scripts and onboarding solutions supporting customer-specific modules, workflows, branding, and application settings.

Technologies: C#, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, WebForms, SQL Server, T-SQL, HL7, JavaScript, Azure DevOps, CI/CD.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Leadership · Agentic AI Development · C# · Web Development · Software Infrastructure · Software Architecture · Software Development · Microsoft SQL Server · Software Systems Engineering · Software Design · .NET Framework · Software Industry

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer at U.S. Figure Skating, I designed, developed, and maintained applications supporting the organizations operations and technology initiatives. I worked full-time for approximately 2.5 years before transitioning to a special-project contractor role for an additional two years.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

Software Development: Designed, developed, and maintained applications using C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, WPF, and mobile technologies.

Technical Leadership: Provided technical guidance, mentored developers, participated in design decisions, and helped resolve complex application issues.

Team Leadership: Served in interim Scrum Master and software development management roles while continuing hands-on development.

Application Delivery: Supported software releases, deployments, production troubleshooting, and DevOps activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Worked with stakeholders and development teams to translate business requirements into practical software solutions.

Special Projects: Continued supporting the organization as a contractor, contributing technical expertise to specialized development initiatives.

Technologies: C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, WPF, mobile application development, Agile/Scrum, DevOps.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Leadership · Software Infrastructure · Software Architecture · Software Development · Scrum · Software Systems Engineering · Software Design · .NET Framework · Software Industry

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
As Software Development Manager at Envision Radiology, I led a team of five software developers responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving healthcare applications supporting 16 radiology centers.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

Team Management: Managed five software developers, overseeing work assignments, priorities, project planning, and software delivery.

Technical Leadership: Provided architectural and technical guidance, participated in design decisions, reviewed solutions, and remained involved in hands-on development.

Cross-Department Collaboration: Worked closely with PACS, Operations, Project Management, and other departments to coordinate integrations, system improvements, and technology initiatives.

Project Delivery: Led requirements gathering, estimation, sprint planning, testing, deployments, and application releases.

Process Improvement: Helped establish and improve Agile/Scrum practices, development workflows, and software delivery processes.

Healthcare Technology: Oversaw development and integration of applications supporting clinical workflows, operational efficiency, and patient services.

Recognition: Received the 2018 Leadership Award.

Technologies: C#, .NET, ASP.NET, SQL Server, HL7, Agile/Scrum, software architecture, team leadership.

positions.title: Senior Software Analyst
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer and Software Analyst at Envision Radiology, I designed and developed enterprise healthcare applications and integrations supporting 16 radiology centers. I worked closely with clinical and operational teams to improve workflows, automate processes, and deliver solutions that addressed real business challenges.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

Application Development: Designed, developed, and maintained enterprise applications using C#, .NET, ASP.NET, and SQL Server.

Healthcare Integrations: Developed HL7 interfaces and integrations connecting clinical systems and supporting the exchange of patient and diagnostic information.

Business Process Improvement: Built solutions to streamline workflows from initial patient contact through radiology report delivery, reducing manual effort and improving operational efficiency.

Requirements and Analysis: Collaborated directly with business stakeholders and end users to understand challenges, define requirements, and develop practical technical solutions.

Database Development: Designed and optimized SQL Server databases, stored procedures, and queries supporting healthcare applications.

Technical Problem-Solving: Investigated complex system issues, improved existing applications, and developed solutions to support evolving business needs.

My work contributed to technology improvements that helped reduce operating costs, improve productivity, and support better patient service.

Technologies: C#, .NET, ASP.NET, SQL Server, T-SQL, HL7, systems integration, business analysis.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer at VisionBox, I developed and maintained custom software applications, contributing to technical design, development, troubleshooting, and application delivery.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

Software Development: Designed, developed, and maintained web and mobile applications to meet client requirements.

NORAD Tracks Santa: Contributed to software development for the NORAD Tracks Santa initiative, supporting a highly visible public-facing project.

Technical Collaboration: Worked with developers and project stakeholders to translate requirements into functional software solutions.

Agile Development: Helped improve Scrum practices and team development processes to support more effective collaboration and delivery.

Problem-Solving: Troubleshot application issues and contributed to improvements in functionality and maintainability.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
As a Software Developer employed by SAIC and assigned to the United States Air Force Academy (USAFA), I contributed to the design, development, and maintenance of mission-planning software supporting Air Force initiatives.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

Mission-Planning Software: Developed and maintained applications supporting military mission-planning requirements.

Application Development: Built and enhanced software using C#, .NET, Windows Forms, WCF, and SQL Server.

Technical Problem-Solving: Investigated application issues, implemented enhancements, and supported the reliability of existing systems.

Agile Collaboration: Participated in Scrum development practices, including sprint planning, team coordination, and iterative software delivery.

Requirements and Design: Collaborated with team members and stakeholders to translate complex operational requirements into working software.

Technologies: C#, .NET, Windows Forms, WCF, SQL Server, Agile/Scrum.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
As a Software Developer at MATCH Services / Eurotech Global Sports, I designed, developed, and maintained applications supporting large-scale international sporting events, including FIFA-related operations.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

Large-Scale Application Development: Developed and maintained a volunteer management portal supporting more than 40,000 volunteers for international sporting events.

Enterprise Software Development: Built and enhanced applications supporting event operations, volunteer coordination, and business processes.

Database Development: Developed database queries and application functionality to manage complex operational information.

Business Requirements: Collaborated with stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate requirements into functional software solutions.

Application Support: Troubleshot issues, implemented enhancements, and maintained applications supporting event operations.

positions.title: Application Developer/DBA
positions.description:
As an Application Developer and Database Administrator at Air Academy Federal Credit Union, I designed, developed, and maintained enterprise applications and database solutions supporting financial services operations.

Key responsibilities and accomplishments:

Application Development: Designed, developed, and maintained web, Windows, and console applications supporting internal business operations.

Database Development: Developed and maintained SQL Server databases, stored procedures, queries, and database-driven applications.

Enterprise Systems: Developed and administered SharePoint solutions to support collaboration, document management, and business processes.

Workflow Automation: Implemented and maintained OnBase document management solutions, workflows, and system integrations to improve operational efficiency.

Systems Integration: Built solutions connecting applications, databases, and enterprise platforms to streamline business processes.

Technical Support: Troubleshot complex application and database issues, implemented enhancements, and supported business-critical systems.

Technologies: C#, .NET, SQL Server, T-SQL, SharePoint, OnBase, Windows applications, enterprise application development.
